title: Rippers Unmasked — Stylish Action HUD (Fabula Ultima bridge)
description: Registers a Project FU (Fabula Ultima) system adapter with the Stylish Action HUD module: a party HUD tracking HP / MP / IP + condition icons, and an action menu for core FU actions (attacks, spells, class skills/features) plus this campaign's custom item types — Arcana (pulse/dismiss, Arcanist-only) and Guises. Uses only SAH's public adapter API (no Project FU fork; no SAH code redistributed). A personal-table module — not for redistribution.

recommends.reason: This module is the SAH adapter; without SAH it loads and no-ops.
Surfaces Arcana (pulse/dismiss) in the action menu.
Surfaces Guises + routes guise actions to its API.

rippers-stylish-hud.note: Registers a 'projectfu' system adapter on Stylish Action HUD via Hooks.once('stylish-action-hud.apiReady'). Scope: HP/MP/IP + conditions on the party HUD; core FU + Arcana (Arcanist-only) + Guises on the action menu. No FU or SAH code redistributed.
